title: Aadhya skin clinic by Dr Nidhi Patel/ Dr Nidhi Patel/ Dermatologist / best skin clinic in vadodara
ownerDescription:
Aadhya Skin Clinic by Dr Nidhi Patel is a one stop destination for both clinical and aesthetic dermatological services.
Treatments available for all Skin, Hair, Nail disorders and Venereal (STD) diseases.
Dermatosurgeries like vitiligo surgery, scar revision, cyst removal, nail excision, skin tag and wart removal are available.
Laser Hair Reduction is performed with US FDA approved latest triple wavelength laser.
Active Q switch nd yag laser for laser toning and carbon peel.
anti ageing treatments like Botox, fillers, thread lift.
Hydrafacial/ medifacials for skin rejuvenation.
Cosmetic treatments for acne, scars, pigmentation, tanning, uneven skin tone, skin glow, etc.
Anti hair fall treatments like microneedling ,PRP, Mesotherapy.
